### Pre-print: "Rich Vehicle Routing Problem in Disaster Management enabling Temporally-causal Transhipments across Multi-Modal Transportation Network"; DOI: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.13227

### This Repository hosts the Datasets (both Synthetically Generated by us and some from the existing Literature).

### Most (all) of the Computational Results are available here: https://doi.org/10.34740/kaggle/dsv/15619388

### Prominent Problem Features:~
- Minimization of the Maximum Vehicle's Route Duration is considered (Makespan Minimization, and using a cascaded approach to find the best among the multiple objectives)
- Multiple diverse types of functional vertices enrich the problem further
- For the first time, the synchronization of transhipment across multiple modes is considered (ensuring temporal causality)

### Subsequently, after acceptance of the paper, the codes will be released by making this connected private repository public: https://github.com/SanTanBan/Cascaded_richVRP_with_WaitingTimes_at_TPs

### The QGIS-Plugin code is available: https://github.com/sid0dodo1/NDMVRP-plugin
The preprint DOI of the plugin will be updated here soon.
